RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so the panel's all-female composition does not suggest sex discrimination. Raising the panel's gender makeup when a woman was appointed is unfounded and risks damaging your professional reputation within the civil service.

The successful candidate offered distinct qualifications—specifically international project leadership—that likely aligned with the ministry's immediate priorities. Instead of questioning panel demographics, send a polite follow-up regarding your requested written feedback. Frame it as seeking constructive guidance to strengthen future promotion opportunities, focusing entirely on objective competency criteria and interview performance.
